about: Known contradictions, counted per coherency check (src/core/08-coherency-checks), that round 2 must remove. Counts may only shrink: tests/suites/coherency.test.mjs fails in CI when a 'quick' count rises, tools/coherency.mjs --baseline=nightly fails the nightly run when a 'nightly' count rises. Lower a count when a step removes contradictions (node tools/coherency.mjs --baseline=<section> --write); never raise one without a line in docs/DECISIONS.md. Empty when round 2 ends (CRITIQUE A3a). Owners: what remains is A2 stage 2 and C6. W1-6 (D-103) added 'an unreasoned upheaval' at 0: every league, petition, answer, rising, claim, coup and quarrel recorded has two reasons or more with a source (war.md §16). D-107 added 'alive past the greatest age' at 0: no one but the player outlives his people's span (GD.RACES[race].maxLife; the lore's elders of 1105 ten years past their age then).
